name: Magnolia – The Universe in a Nutshell, from the Whispers of Trees series
summary: A square black and white photograph is mounted on a white hanging scroll with gold edging. In the photograph, two thin wisteria branches lie vertically on a blank surface, cropped at the bottom and casting shadows downwards. Upon close inspection, Chinese writing is in gold ink is visible in the shadows.
